sections.text: The synthetic body controller project controls exterior lights. It contains LightSensor, LightController and LampDriver.

Component: LightSensor | input: AmbientLight | output: LightLevel | period_ms: 100
Component: LightController | input: LightLevel | output: LampCommand | period_ms: 50
Component: LampDriver | input: LampCommand | output: LampState | period_ms: 20

Signal: LightLevel | producer: LightSensor | consumer: LightController | unit: lux | min: 0 | max: 100000
Signal: LampCommand | producer: LightController | consumer: LampDriver | unit: boolean | min: 0 | max: 1
If LightLevel is unavailable for 500 ms, LightController switches lamps on and records LIGHT_SENSOR_TIMEOUT.

Dependency: LightController -> LightSensor
Dependency: LampDriver -> LightController
